changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwurgentcaremedicationorder AS SELECT ucm.id, ucm.patient_id, ucm.encounter_id, ucm.active_ingredient_id, ucm.instruction_type, ucm.instruction_text, ucm.dose, ucm.dose_unit, ucm.route, ucm.is_high_alert, ucm.status, ucm.submitted_date, ucm.submitted_by, ucm.administered_date, ucm.administered_by, ucm.double_checked_date, ucm.double_checked_by, ucm.discarded_date, ucm.discarded_by, ucm.discard_reason, ucm.cancelled_date, ucm.cancelled_by, ucm.cancellation_reason, ucm.created_by, ucm.created_date, ucm.last_modified_by, ucm.last_modified_date, ucm.actual_administer_time, ucm.frequency_number, ucm.frequency_unit, ucm.duration, ucm.start_time, ucm.dose_time, ucm.order_group_id, ucm.frequency FROM public.urgent_care_medication_order ucm;
